### **Powercraft 2**
A remake of Powercraft. For 1.21.8.
This version includes 9 new bosses, and over 200 items for you to use!
Alongside a selection of reimagined and completely new classes!
This pack has something for everyone!

The story sets as a mysterious traveler is spoken to by the cosmic void.
What adventures awaits? What stories unfold?
Time shall tell..
